dict.string: Notchfall shows your camera inside the island when you click Camera check, so you can see yourself before joining a meeting. The picture never leaves your Mac and isn't recorded.
Notchfall reads your calendar so it can drop an alert out of the notch before a meeting starts. Nothing leaves your Mac.

Notchfall reads your reminders so it can alert you when one is due. It never changes them.
